items.title: How Institutions Can Measure Career Readiness in Real Time
items.description: UT San Antonio's Mario Vela explains why opt-in career services no longer work — and how a real-time career readiness index makes career outcomes measurable.

items.title: Doing More Without Adding Headcount in Higher Education
items.description: NDSU Provost Shari Veil explains how colleges can do more without adding headcount by using data, rethinking work, and aligning resources to student needs.

items.title: 5 Questions to Ask Before Buying an AI Agent for Higher Ed
items.description: Before buying an AI agent, ask what information it's acting on, not just what it can do. Learn five questions every higher ed leader should ask before making a decision.

items.title: Designing Student Support Around Student Needs, Not Institutional Structures
items.description: Page Keller shares how colleges can redesign student support around today's students by reducing friction and improving access.

items.title: Inaction Has a Price: The Hidden Cost of Delayed Student Success Investments
items.description: Explore the hidden costs of delay and why the status quo deserves just as much scrutiny as any technology vendor.

items.title: Access Isn't Readiness: How First-Gen Students Build Financial Confidence
items.description: Dr. Charmaine Troy arrived at college with $20 in her pocket. She shares how that experience shaped her view of first-generation student success—and why access alone isn't enough.

items.title: The Hidden Cost of the Wrong Technology
items.description: Anyone can run a good demo. Few vendors are still there for you a year after go-live.

items.title: Coordination Without Centralization: How UC Built Student Success at Scale
items.description: Tara Warden from the University of Cincinnati shares the decisions and outcomes behind one of the most coordinated student success systems in public higher education.

/resources/2024-student-success-impact-r.title: 2024 Student Success Impact Report Webinar | Civitas Learning
/resources/2024-student-success-impact-r.headline: Insights to Action: An inside look at the 2024 Student Success Impact Report
/resources/2024-student-success-impact-r.sub: Each year, Civitas Learning conducts a meta-analysis of hundreds of initiatives to provide actionable insights on how institutions can improve their specific student success efforts.

sections.heading: About the Webinar
sections.body: This year's research examines long-term and recent practices that improve persistence to graduation. The webinar features conversation between data and content professionals discussing report findings and implications for higher education leaders.

sections.heading: What You'll Learn
bullets: The top-performing strategies uncovered by the research
What types of programs work best for different groups of students
How Civitas Learning partners are organizing data-activated strategic efforts and application strategies for leaders

sections.heading: Presenters
bullets: Sarah DeMeo, Data Analyst — 10 years in higher education (academic and student affairs); MBA from Bentley University; Master of Education from UCLA

Katy Oliveira, Senior Content Strategist — 15-year higher education career in student success roles (academic advisor, advising leader, faculty member); producer and host of Next Practices podcast and Apple Podcast-featured show Collegehood Advice
